title: Interactive Coding: Four Math Operators
subtitle: Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, Division
description: Master arithmetic operations across 4 interactive stages!
starter_code:
a = 10
b = 5
# Stage 1: Print the sum of a and b

challenges.title: Stage 1: Addition (+)
challenges.description: Given <hlt>a = 10</hlt> and <hlt>b = 5</hlt>, compute and print their sum: <hlt>print(a + b)</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
a = 10
b = 5
# Stage 1: Addition
print(a + b)

challenges.title: Stage 2: Subtraction (-)
challenges.description: Compute and print the subtraction difference: <hlt>print(a - b)</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
a = 10
b = 5
# Stage 2: Subtraction
print(a - b)

challenges.title: Stage 3: Multiplication (*)
challenges.description: Compute and print the multiplication product: <hlt>print(a * b)</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
a = 10
b = 5
# Stage 3: Multiplication
print(a * b)

challenges.title: Stage 4: Division & Precedence
challenges.description: Compute division <hlt>print(a / b)</hlt> and bracketed combo <hlt>print((a + b) * 2)</hlt>.
challenges.starter_code:
a = 10
b = 5
# Stage 4: Division & Precedence
print(a / b)
print((a + b) * 2)
